title: Fuzz report
description: One fuzz run of one target, held by an assessment of kind `fuzz` (run-bound: the assessment owns the repository, commit, producer and time, so they are not repeated here). Records what ran, every crasher that is a candidate finding, measured coverage, and the surfaces that were not fuzzed and why. Crashers enter the finding lane through intake, one finding per crasher; this document is their evidence. Only fuzz execution produces a crasher: bugs confirmed by static review or a grep sweep are not recorded here. A run that found nothing records no crasher, never a claim of correctness. Run counts (clean, crashed, failed) derive from the harness outcomes and are not stored.

coverage.description: Code coverage of the final corpus, measured by a coverage tool. null: not measured.

id.description: The campaign's target id (one repository, or a refined re-fuzz sharing a clone).

module.description: Module or package coordinate the harnesses import (e.g. a Go module path).

name.description: Fuzz entry point (Go FuzzXxx, Jazzer class, cargo-fuzz target). Unique within the document.

path.description: Repository-relative path the harness was installed at.

execs.description: Executions reported by the engine. null: the engine did not report.

corpus_entries.description: Inputs in the corpus at the end of the run. null: not reported.

engine.description: go_native: `go test -fuzz`. cargo_fuzz runs libFuzzer through cargo; jazzer_js is Jazzer.js.

outcome.description: clean: ran its duration with no crasher. crashed: wrote at least one crashing input. failed: the harness or build failed without a crashing input. not_run: the engine found nothing to fuzz.

id.description: Unique within the document; the finding's source id at intake.

harness.description: The target harness `name` that produced it (the recording service checks the reference).

sanitizer.description: The sanitizer that reported the crash. null: none (memory-safe runtimes, property checks).

severity_proposal.description: The producer's proposal; triage owns the severity.

location.description: Where the crash surfaces (top in-repository frame), when known.

finding_id.description: An existing finding this crasher confirms. Absent: intake mints a new finding.

stack_hash.description: Hash of the normalized top frames, for dedupe across runs. null: no stack (property violation, timeout without a trace).

frames.description: How many top frames the hash covers.

crash_class.description: invariant_violation: a property the harness asserts failed (open redirect, integer wrap, path escape) without a crash. process_exit: the target exited the process (os.Exit, abort).

sha256.description: Digest of the minimized crashing input's exact bytes.

uri.description: Where the bytes are kept (a location, never parsed for meaning).

path.description: Repository-relative path the engine wrote it to (e.g. testdata/fuzz/FuzzX/<hash>).

surface.description: Function, package or path left unfuzzed.

harness.description: The harness concerned, for harness_defect and build_failed.

gap_reason.description: no_harness: tracked without a fuzzer (static-confirmed or covered by another harness). fuzzed_upstream: already continuously fuzzed (e.g. OSS-Fuzz). trusted_input: input is not attacker-controlled. harness_defect: crashers came from the harness, not the target, so the surface is untested.
